packet.title: Packages, minimal (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements minimal XSLT packages: xsl:package, use-package through the resolver with version ranges, visibility, and accept, expose and override for each component kind.

body.p: After . Owns src/xslt_package.c, tests/xslt_package_test.c. xsl:package, use-package through the resolver (package-version ranges), visibility (public, private, final, abstract, hidden), accept, expose, override for functions, templates, variables, attribute sets and modes. Done when decl-package, use-package, accept, expose, override, attr-package-version ≥ 70%. Done 2026-10-19 (): src/xslt_package.c (the package table), the reader's USED_PACKAGE modules, binding in the XSLT lowering, tests/xslt_package_test.c, the driver's version choice. In scope: package 94 %, override 89 %, accept 96 %, expose 100 %, package-version 97 %, use-package 64 % (76 % of the cases run: 8 need another package_version_resolution, 1 streaming).
